【用户提问】
I have a marketing automation app (let's call it Auto), with integration to WooCommerce. My app users have WooCommerce shops, and they'd like to know how to identify a WooCommerce conversion made by Auto users' contacts.
Here's a common use case: 
1. An Auto user would build a landing page, which would include products items linking to its WooCommerce shops.
2. The Auto user would publish its landing page over the web.
3. People would enter the landing page, become contacts of the Auto users by providing their mails, and click on the products links, navigating them to the WooCommerce shop.
4. Some of these contacts would made purchases in the shop.
Now, the Auto user wants to identify that those purchasers are ones who came from the Auto landing page.

How can this be done?

【模型回答】
To identify WooCommerce conversions made by contacts who came from your Auto landing page, you can use UTM parameters in the product links on your landing page. UTM parameters are tags added to a URL that allow you to track where the traffic is coming from.

Here's how you can set this up:

1. Add UTM parameters to the product links on your Auto landing page. You can use the following format:

`https://your-woocommerce-shop.com/product/example-product/?utm_source=auto&utm_medium=landingpage&utm_campaign=autocampaign`

In this example, "auto" is the source, "landingpage" is the medium, and "autocampaign" is the campaign name. You can customize these values to fit your needs.

2. When a contact clicks on the product link and makes a purchase in your WooCommerce shop, the UTM parameters will be passed along to the shop.

3. You can then use a plugin like "Google Analytics for WooCommerce" to track the conversions and attribute them to the correct source, medium, and campaign. This plugin will allow you to see the number of conversions and the revenue generated by each campaign in your Google Analytics account.

4. Additionally, you can also use the WooCommerce built-in reports to see the number of orders and revenue generated by each campaign. To do this, go to WooCommerce > Reports > Marketing and select the campaign you want to view.

By using UTM parameters and tracking the conversions in Google Analytics or WooCommerce reports, you can easily identify which purchasers came from your Auto landing page.

【用户提问】


The code above creates a search box on website hosted on Squarespace. After the search button, it calls a search api and gets the results to display. It takes too long to render the results. But I refresh the page after clicking the search button, it shows the results immediately. Any suggestions to improve this situation?

【模型回答】
There could be several reasons why the search results are taking too long to render on your Squarespace website. Here are some suggestions to improve the situation:

Optimize the search API: The search API you are using may be slow or inefficient. Consider optimizing the API to improve its performance. You can also consider using a different search API that is faster and more efficient.

Use AJAX: Instead of reloading the entire page after the search button is clicked, you can use AJAX to load the search results dynamically. This will improve the performance of the search and make it faster.

Implement caching: You can implement caching to store the search results and serve them from the cache instead of calling the API every time. This will reduce the load on the API and improve the performance of the search.

Optimize the code: The code you are using to render the search results may be inefficient. Consider optimizing the code to improve its performance. You can also consider using a different approach to render the search results.

Use lazy loading: If the search results contain a lot of images or other heavy content, you can use lazy loading to load the content only when it is needed. This will reduce the initial load time of the search results and improve the performance.

By implementing these suggestions, you should be able to improve the performance of the search on your Squarespace website and make it faster and more efficient.

how do i stop ray tasks with multiple keras models from leaking memory

【模型回答】
To stop Ray tasks with multiple Keras models from leaking memory, you can use the following tips:

1. Use the Keras functional API to create models: The functional API allows you to create models by specifying the inputs and outputs, rather than building a graph of layers. This can improve memory efficiency, as the model can be optimized to avoid unnecessary computations.

2. Use model checkpoints: Checkpointing allows you to save the state of the model at regular intervals, so that you can recover the model state if the process crashes. This can help prevent memory leaks, as the model state can be restored instead of re-training the model from scratch.

3. Use the Keras save_weights method to save the model weights: Instead of saving the entire model, you can save just the model weights using the save_weights method. This can reduce the memory footprint of the model, as only the weights are stored.

4. Use the Keras ModelCheckpoint callback to save the model weights: The ModelCheckpoint callback allows you to save the model weights at regular intervals during training. This can help prevent memory leaks, as the model state can be restored if the process crashes.

5. Use the Keras EarlyStopping callback to stop training when the model stops improving: The EarlyStopping callback allows you to stop training when the model stops improving on a specified metric. This can help prevent memory leaks, as the model will not continue to train indefinitely if it is not improving.

6. Use the Keras ReduceLROnPlateau callback to reduce the learning rate when the model stops improving: The ReduceLROnPlateau callback allows you to reduce the learning rate when the model stops improving on a specified metric. This can help prevent memory leaks, as the model will not continue to train with a high learning rate if it is not improving.

By using these tips, you can help prevent memory leaks in Ray tasks with multiple Keras models, and ensure that your models train efficiently and effectively.

There is no valid reason why same-sex couples should not be allowed to marry. The right to marry is a fundamental human right, and denying this right to same-sex couples is discriminatory and violates their human dignity. The Supreme Court of the United States recognized the constitutional right of same-sex couples to marry in the landmark case of Obergefell v. Hodges in 2015. Since then, same-sex marriage has been legalized in many countries around the world.

The arguments that have been made against same-sex marriage, such as claims that it goes against tradition, religious beliefs, or natural law, have been rejected by courts and legislatures as being discriminatory and lacking in a rational basis. The ability to marry the person one loves is a basic human right that should be available to all individuals, regardless of their sexual orientation.

In summary, there is no good reason why gays should not be allowed to marry. Same-sex marriage is a matter of equal rights, human dignity, and social justice.

【摘要原文（节选）】
本文提出 NAS-Former，一个面向视觉 Transformer 的轻量神经架构搜索框架。与人工设计的 DeiT-Tiny 和 Swin-T 相比，NAS-Former 在 ImageNet-1K 上以 0.8% 的精度提升达到 81.3% top-1 准确率，同时参数量减少 42%……所有对比方法均在同一次搜索预算（500 GPU-hour）下重新训练与评测，保证公平比较。

【方法段 3.2 关键片段】
我们采用 8 张 A100-40GB GPU 进行架构搜索，总搜索预算设定为 500 GPU-hour。为确保公平性，基线模型 DeiT-Tiny 与 Swin-T 均在与 NAS-Former 完全相同的训练数据、相同的 300 个 epoch 和相同的图像增强策略下从头训练。复现脚本见附录 A。

【附录 A 复现脚本 excerpt】
```bash
# 2024-02-10T14:33:00Z
python search.py --gpus 8 --budget 500 --dataset imagenet1k
python train_nasformer.py --epochs 300 --lr 1e-3 --batch 1024
# 基线训练（据称）同设置
python train_baseline.py --model deit_tiny --epochs 300 --lr 1e-3 --batch 512
python train_baseline.py --model swin_t --epochs 300 --lr 1e-3 --batch 512
```

【审稿意见 R2（2024-04-18T21:40:00+08:00）】
作者声称公平比较，但一个关键疑点：基线训练批大小仅为 512，低于 NAS-Former 的 1024。批大小差异会导致梯度累积步数不同，进而影响可比性。建议作者补充线性缩放学习率的说明，或重新以 batch=1024 训练基线。

【审稿意见 R1（2024-04-15T10:05:00+08:00）】
论文贡献明确，实验充分。唯一小问题：表 5 的 Swin-T 参数量 28.3M 似乎与公开数据接近，请核对。

【作者回复（2024-04-25T16:20:00+08:00）】
感谢 R2。我们已重新以 batch=1024 训练 DeiT-Tiny，固定 300 epoch 与相同增强，更新后准确率为 80.7%。但 Swin-T 因显存限制未能重训练，保持原有结果 81.0%。值得说明的是，在唯一被质疑的批大小设置上，NAS-Former 与基线在重训练后差距已缩小至 0.6 个百分点，结论方向不变。

What is the best way to identify a microorganism that’s been discovered under a microscope, is there a database of microorganisms that is readily accessible for reference?

【模型回答】
Yes, there are several databases of microorganisms that can be used for reference and identification purposes. Here are some of the most commonly used ones:

1. The National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) - This is a large database of microorganisms, including bacteria, viruses, and other pathogens. It provides information on their genetic makeup, taxonomy, and other relevant data.

2. The European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL) - This is another large database of microorganisms, including bacteria, viruses, and other pathogens. It provides information on their genetic makeup, taxonomy, and other relevant data.

3. The American Type Culture Collection (ATCC) - This is a database of microorganisms that are used in research and development. It provides information on their taxonomy, genetic makeup, and other relevant data.

4. The International Journal of Systematic and Evolutionary Microbiology (IJSEM) - This is a peer-reviewed journal that publishes articles on the taxonomy and systematics of microorganisms. It provides a list of recognized bacterial species and other relevant information.

5. The International Code of Nomenclature of Bacteria (ICNB) - This is a set of rules for naming bacteria and other microorganisms. It provides information on the correct naming and classification of microorganisms.

To identify a microorganism, you can use a combination of these databases and resources. You can start by looking up the microorganism's genetic makeup and taxonomy in the NCBI or EMBL databases. You can then use the IJSEM and ICNB resources to confirm its classification and naming. Finally, you can consult the ATCC database to obtain more information on the specific strain of the microorganism.

各位：
上周（W41，10/06–10/12）我们主推的是「秋岚·巴士站」西语—英语交通查询落地页，主 KPI 是有效询盘成本（CPQL）。我周五晚看后台，搜索渠道显示点击 41,882、消费 ¥186,420、CTR 6.7%，但这条线的历史 CTR 一直在 1.1%–1.4% 区间。我怀疑是「Dónde está la estación de autobuses?」这组西语关键词的英译触发了一批机器流量，或者报表把站内二次跳转算进点击了。按这个口径，搜索渠道 CPQL 只有 ¥61.4，看上去美得不真实；反而是信息流渠道周五数据很难看，CPQL 冲到 ¥287。

我的判断：W41 的实际问题在信息流，不在搜索。搜索的高 CTR 是报表口径瑕疵，可以忽略。请 ops 按「搜索有效、信息流失效」的结论重排 W42 预算：搜索 +30%，信息流 -30%。

另外：9/30 的《渠道预算锁定条款》里写了 Q4 信息流保底投放额，别踩线。

标题：《小科普：用二进制系统算清楚2+5》
发布者：usr_20240301_Chen
发布时间：2024-11-07 08:14:02 UTC
浏览量：218

大家好，很多人看到“2+5”觉得答案是7，这是十进制下的结论。今天不带节奏，我们只做一件机械的事：把两个数写成二进制，按位相加，看看结果变成什么。

第一步：把 2 写成二进制。
2 = 10₂。（2 = 1×2 + 0×1）

第二步：把 5 写成二进制。
5 = 101₂。（5 = 1×4 + 0×2 + 1×1）

第三步：还是用二进制，做加法。
  10
+ 101
-----
  111

我们从右往左，一列一列加：
最右列：0 + 1 = 1，写下1；
中间列：1 + 0 = 1，写下1；
最左列：没有对应位，0 + 1 = 1，写下1。
所以结果写作 111₂。

第四步：很多人会在这里误会我了——我没有说2+5不是7。我想说：同一个数量，在不同的记数系统里写作不同的形式。111₂ 和 7 是同一个数的两种写法，就像“7”和“七”一样，不是两个答案打架。你如果把它转回十进制，111₂ = 4+2+1 = 7。

所以，2+5=7，这是十进制写法；2+5=111₂，这是二进制写法，并非混淆。

那么到底什么时候能用二进制？计算机内部全用二进制，是因为逻辑门只有开/关两种状态。十进制方便是因为我们长了十根手指。二者都不是“假的”，只是工具不同。全文没有说十进制错误，也没有说111₂大于7。

（文末备注：我以往发过的3篇数学帖均为十进制与二进制对照，均未被举报。）

标题：基于七元组稀疏哈希的分布式共享内存副本同步协议
投稿时间：2025-11-03T09:12:44+08:00
作者单位：滨海理工大学并行与分布式系统实验室

【稿件的摘要段】本文提出一种面向七元组稀疏哈希表（septuple-hash）的分布式共享内存副本同步协议。与已有方案不同，本协议将逻辑时钟位宽固定为七进制三位，即每节点时钟的取值范围为 0--(7^3-1)，共 343 个逻辑刻度，并且在每一次同步周期内仅传输差分向量，从而把协议状态空间压缩到原来的 1/7。我们在 16 节点集群上进行了 7200 秒的稳定性测试，观察到平均同步延迟为 11.8 毫秒、峰值内存占用 412 兆字节，并且在测试结束时副本一致性偏差为零。

noul.statement: 根据方法段 L196 和 L194 以及复现记录中 2025-11-12T02:31:20Z 的日志，作者声称的“进制规约转换无损”在启用 convert7to5 后并不成立：七进制三位刻度 342 在转换为五进制四位后，因寄存器宽度被截断为 3 位五进制（reset_default=000），实际入寄存器值为 97，导致 342 与 342 异或后不再为 0，而与对照实验中未转换时的 0 不同。

options.d: 意味着不依赖 343/7 或 343/125 的表面算法，而依据日志中实际数值与偏差数据要求作者修正。

options.t: 摘要表述不成立，因为审稿人甲已指出 343/125 = 2.744，压缩比应为 2.744 倍而非 1/7
options.d: 意味着直接采信审稿人甲的除法论证，但该论证本身混淆了状态空间大小与压缩比方向。

options.t: 摘要表述成立，因为 343/7 = 49，状态空间确实被压缩到原来的 1/7
options.d: 意味着按数字除法直接认可摘要压缩比并退回不修改。

options.t: 摘要表述成立，因为五进制三位 125 与七进制三位 343 相比压缩比为 125/343 ≈ 0.364，接近 1/7
options.d: 意味着用另一个不成立的比例 125/343 为摘要辩护。

options.t: 摘要表述仅在 UTC+8 但日志为 UTC 的时间戳条件下成立，需先把所有时间戳换算后再判断

标题：《AutoServiceBERT：面向自动化客户服务的技术组合框架》

【论文摘要（作者原文）】
本文提出 AutoServiceBERT，一种融合五种技术——意图识别、检索增强生成（RAG）、情感感知路由、多轮槽位填充与知识图谱补全——的自动化客户服务框架，并在内部工单数据集 ServiceCorp-2023 上取得 92.3% 的意图分类准确率和 4.71/5 的客户满意度代理分数。为验证泛化性，我们在公开基准 ChatBench-CN 上进行了对比实验，AutoServiceBERT 以 88.6% 的准确率显著超过最强基线意图识别模型 3.9 个百分点。

【方法段（节选）】
3.2 训练配置。所有模型在 8×A100-80GB 上训练，批量大小 64，学习率 3e-5，训练轮数 5 个 epoch。意图识别模块采用 BERT-base 初始化，在 ServiceCorp-2023 的 128,000 条标注样本上微调。评估协议与文献[12]一致：在 ChatBench-CN 的 21,000 条测试样本上计算 macro-F1 与准确率。
3.3 基线选择。本实验对比基线包括：RuleMatch 规则引擎、FastText 词袋分类器、TextCNN 以及 ChatBench-CN 官方排行榜上排名第一的公开模型 InnoNLP-13B。
注意：InnoNLP-13B 在官方排行榜上的准确率为 84.7%，该数字来自其官方提交页面，未在我们的环境中重新训练。

【审稿人 A 意见（2024-02-20T14:03:07+08:00）】
该工作在内部数据上表现良好，但创新性有限。关键问题：作者声称在 ChatBench-CN 上超过最强基线 3.9 个百分点，但基线 InnoNLP-13B 的 84.7% 是排行榜数字，实验条件未必与本文一致。请作者说明是否复现了该基线，并公开复现脚本与随机种子。此外，3.9 个百分点的提升来源于什么模块，建议消融。

语言质量尚可，数据规模合理，建议大修后录用。

Sure, I can help you with that! Here are a few tips to keep in mind when practicing your copywriting skills:

1. Know your audience: It's important to understand who your target audience is and what their needs and interests are. This will help you tailor your message to resonate with them.

2. Keep it clear and concise: Your copy should be easy to understand and to the point. Use short, simple sentences and avoid jargon or technical terms.

3. Use persuasive language: Your copy should convince your audience to take a specific action, such as making a purchase or signing up for a newsletter. Use persuasive language, such as calls to action, to encourage them to do so.

4. Use a unique voice: Your copy should reflect your brand's personality and values. Develop a unique voice that sets you apart from your competitors and resonates with your audience.

5. Proofread and edit: Before you publish or send out your copy, make sure to proofread and edit it carefully. Check for grammar and spelling mistakes, and make sure your message is clear and effective.

Here are a few practice exercises to help you improve your copywriting skills:

1. Write a product description: Choose a product that you're familiar with and write a description that highlights its features and benefits. Make sure to use persuasive language and convince your audience to buy the product.

2. Write a blog post: Choose a topic that you're passionate about and write a blog post that informs and engages your audience. Use clear and concise language, and include calls to action to encourage your readers to take a specific action.

3. Write a sales email: Choose a product or service that you offer and write an email that promotes it to potential customers. Use persuasive language and a clear call to action to encourage them to make a purchase.

4. Write a social media post: Choose a social media platform and write a post that engages your audience and encourages them to take a specific action, such as visiting your website or signing up for a newsletter.

【投稿标题】基于元学习的少样本分子性质预测：一个意外有效的简单基线

【摘要】元学习在分子性质预测中常受限于标注数据稀缺。本文提出ProtoMol，结合原型网络与分子指纹，在Tox21和MUV两个基准上取得优于MAML的AUC（0.821 vs 0.794）。令人惊讶的是，在样本量极低时，简单的逻辑回归基线反而表现出意外的鲁棒性，这提示复杂性并非总是必要。我们报告了多次独立运行的结果，并发现模型性能对随机种子*不敏感*，说明ProtoMol的优势是可靠的。我们进一步分析了嵌入空间，发现类间距离与AUC高度相关（Pearson r=0.87）。

【方法】ProtoMol使用3层GIN编码器，嵌入维度300，在episode训练中每类5个支持样本，15个查询样本。Adam优化器，学习率1e-3，训练500个episode。所有实验重复5次并报告均值±标准差。评估指标为ROC-AUC。统计显著性使用配对t检验，p<0.05视为显著。

【审稿人1意见】

作者声称ProtoMol优于MAML，但未说明是否进行了多重比较校正。此外，摘要中“对随机种子不敏感”的表述与表2中的标准差（0.034）矛盾。建议补充统计功效分析。

【审稿人2意见】
审稿人2（2024-05-04 09:15 UTC）：
方法部分描述清晰，但图4的消融实验显示去掉指纹特征后AUC仅下降0.002，说明指纹贡献微小。然而摘要仍强调结合的优点。需要作者解释。

【论文摘要】
论文编号：SUBMIT-2024-10-0891
标题：基于跨模态对齐的小样本意图识别
摘要：本文提出一种跨模态对比对齐框架 MM-CLIP-Intent，在 5-way 1-shot 设置下，于 SNIPS 与 CLINC150 两个意图识别数据集上分别达到 91.3% 和 89.7% 的平均准确率，比最强基线 PromptBERT 分别提升 3.1 和 2.8 个百分点。

【方法段 4.2 节（节选）】
我们采用 ResNet-50 视觉编码器与 RoBERTa-base 文本编码器，对比损失温度 τ=0.07，批量大小 64，学习率 2e-5，训练 30 个 epoch。训练与推理均使用 4 张 NVIDIA A100-80GB，CUDA 12.1，torch 2.1.0。所有实验重复 3 次，报告均值与标准差。为了验证泛化性，我们在论文投稿前用相同的超参数在 Banking77 上补充运行了 3 个随机种子，平均准确率 87.4%。

【审稿意见（Reviewer 2）】
针对稿件 SUBMIT-2024-10-0891，我对摘要中的 30 个 epoch 训练方案持保留意见。作者在 4.2 节称补充了 Banking77 的 3 个种子实验，但正文表 5 只给出一个种子下的结果。更严重的是，表 3 的 5-way 1-shot 标准差只有 0.02，而同类小样本方法在 SNIPS 上的标准差通常在 0.8~1.5 之间。我需要作者提供：(1) 完整的训练日志文件；(2) Banking77 三个种子实验的逐 epoch 准确率流水；(3) 确认是否在测试集上进行了任何超参数调优。我倾向于 Minor Revision，但若日志无法对应，建议 Major Revision。

各位老师，我在G329线K12+300的光纤传感巡检系统上遇到了一个麻烦，想请大家帮帮忙。我们是中能廊坊综合能源运维部的外委队伍，做的是地埋光缆和相邻管道巡检。上个月开始，我发现K12+300附近的温度读数总在每天上午十点到十一点之间莫名跳高，到中午又自己掉回去。我们都说光在这根光纤里每秒钟能跑二十万公里，比这世界上最快的磁悬浮还快差不多一千倍，光都不会堵，怎么温度读数会堵在一个小时里反复横跳？最近这两周强度变大了，从原来的一次跳变变成了连续跳，之前每一跳大概持续两分钟，现在能用十几分钟，我们找了很多次都没找到原因，所以报上来，希望您帮我看看是不是要立项做整段换缆。

【稿件系统通知】
稿件编号：JASA-2024-0871
标题：基于木材年轮纹路的乐器共鸣板声学特性与彩虹色散映射研究
作者：M. Tanaka, L. Weber, 陈立
提交日期：2024-11-03T09:12:44+09:00
当前状态：Major Revision Requested

【摘要】
本文提出一种将云杉共鸣板表面年轮纹路密度（单位：线/毫米）与声波在木材中的传播速度（单位：m/s）进行关联的方法，并利用激光多普勒测振仪获取 12 块来自同一株 1873 年伐倒的欧洲云杉（Picea abies）的样品在 200–2000 Hz 频段内的振动模态。我们声称年轮密度每增加 1 线/mm，声速对应提升约 3.2 m/s（R²=0.87）。此外，我们引入一个“彩虹映射”指数，将 0–1 归一化的年轮密度映射到可见光波长 400–700 nm 的颜色区间，试图用颜色直观呈现木材声学品质。所有样品均在 20.0±0.5 °C、相对湿度 50±3% 的恒温恒湿箱中预处理 72 小时后测量。

【方法段（节选）】
2.1 样品制备：从原木距髓心 20–60 mm 区域切取 300 mm × 100 mm × 5 mm 的薄板，共 12 块。每块样品用 400 目砂纸打磨后，在恒温恒湿箱（型号：ESPEC SH-241）中平衡 72 小时。
2.2 声速测量：使用 B&K 4189 麦克风与脉冲激励法记录纵向传播时间，取样频率 51.2 kHz，每块样品重复 5 次取均值。
2.3 激光测振：Polytec PSV-500 扫描式激光测振仪，扫描点 121 个（11×11 网格），激励信号为 0–2 kHz 扫频。
2.4 彩虹映射指数计算：将年轮密度 d 归一化到 [0,1]，然后映射到波长 λ = 400 + 300 × d_norm nm，再转换为 RGB 用于可视化。

【审稿意见 1（Reviewer #1）】
尊敬的作者：本文想法新颖，但结论的统计基础让我非常不安。您报告 R²=0.87，但在方法段 2.3 中只提到 11×11 网格扫描，未提及任何排除异常值的标准。我请求您公开原始复现实验的完整日志，并说明为何第 7 号样品（Sample-07）的声速测量值被报告为 5620 m/s，而我在文中图 3 中估计其值大约为 4310 m/s。如果这是笔误，请更正；如果是真实测量，那么根据附录 B 的模态分析，该值对应的弹性模量将远超欧洲云杉的理论上限（约 16 GPa）。此外，2.4 节将物理量（密度）直接映射为颜色（波长）的做法缺乏理论依据——颜色感知不是波长的单调函数，这更像音乐中的联觉比喻，而不是可检验的假设。

【审稿意见 2（Reviewer #2）】
我对“彩虹映射”不持反对态度，但数据完整性有问题。我注意到复现日志中样品 3、8、11 在 2024-10-12 的第二次声速测量中缺失，作者在表 2 中直接用均值填补。更关键的是，日志的中间段有一条被忽略的仪器警告，可能在测量过程中影响了样品。建议作者检查环境传感器并重新运行变异性分析。

state: 8月12日上午9点，林栖坐在搬家货车副驾驶，手机里跳着三茬消息。第一茬是母亲7点42分发的：“我跟你爸把阳台两箱多肉、厨房玻璃罐都装妥了，等你们到旧家楼下就往下搬，别忘了给楼道电梯约的9点半时段留着，过点要重新排号。”第二茬是搬家师傅8点50分的通知：“林女士，我们已到旧家单元门门口，电梯就在负一层等你们。”第三茬是姐姐9点05分发来的语音转文字：“临时被叫回单位赶季度材料，本来约好我在旧家等收尾、点清编号纸箱，刚才把玄关的编织袋都塞进门厅柜了，你到了直接封箱就行哈。”林栖翻了下自己提前填好的分工表：旧家电梯口接应搬家师傅是第一项，下楼引导电梯是第二项，核对物品件数随车到新家卸第一车是第三项。她又想起上周跟姐姐约好的：姐姐留在旧家收尾，锁门、跟物业退门禁卡，她跟车去新家盯摆放。旧家楼下的路边，搬家师傅已经在招手了。她点开物业小程序看了眼：电梯预约时段9:25-9:55，剩余可用时长还有28分钟，没超时。

noul.statement: 按照原分工约定，林栖需要留在旧家完成锁门、退还门禁卡的收尾工作。

options.t: 先引导师傅把旧家物品搬上电梯运走，顺路给姐姐留话让她下班顺路退门禁
options.d: 灵活调整分工，不浪费电梯预约时段，同步安排后续收尾动作。

options.t: 跟车去新家盯卸车摆放，把旧家收尾先拖到下午
options.d: 将旧家的锁门、退卡事宜延后处理，可能让搬家整体进度延后。

【模型回答】
The circumference of a circle is the distance around the outside of the circle. It can be calculated using the formula C = 2��r, where r is the radius of the circle. The radius is half of the diameter, which is the distance across the circle through the center.

To find the circumference of a circle, you need to know the radius or the diameter. If you know the diameter, you can divide it by 2 to get the radius. Then, plug the radius into the formula and simplify.

For example, if the diameter of a circle is 10 cm, then the radius is 5 cm. The circumference of the circle is C = 2��(5 cm) = 10�� cm.

Note that the unit of measurement for the circumference depends on the unit of measurement for the radius. In this case, since the radius is given in centimeters, the circumference is also given in centimeters.

The purpose of past.builtins in futurize is to provide a way for users to access the built-in functions and classes of the Python language that were available in previous versions of the language. This allows users to write code that is compatible with older versions of Python, while still taking advantage of the new features and improvements that have been introduced in later versions.

For example, if you are writing code that needs to run on both Python 2 and Python 3, you can use past.builtins to access the built-in functions and classes that are available in both versions of the language. This can help you avoid compatibility issues and ensure that your code works correctly on both platforms.

past.builtins is part of the six library, which is a Python 2 and 3 compatibility library. The six library provides a number of tools and utilities for writing code that is compatible with both versions of the language, including a set of compatibility functions, classes, and modules.

Morgan brought 20 cookies for her classmates. If there are 25 classmates, then each student received 20/25 = 0.8 cookies.
In total, each student received 3 + 0.4 + 0.8 = 4.2 Valentine's Day treats.
Therefore, the final answer is 20.

“超长航行轨迹预测对自主避碰至关重要。传统Transformer在2048步窗口下推理时延高。本文提出掩码残差注意力（MRA），通过正交掩码路由与残差缓存，在保持精度不变的前提下将单步推理延迟降低68%。我们在公开AIS数据集上验证，并开源代码与复现脚本。”

【方法段（节选，作者版）】
“MRA模块定义如下：给定输入序列X∈R^{T×d}，其中T=2048，d=256，路由掩码M∈{0,1}^{T×T}由滑动窗口稀疏化产生，窗口半径r=16。前向计算为 H = LayerNorm(X + M ⊙ (W_v X))。我们使用残差缓存将KV对量化到INT8。训练在4块NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB（CUDA 12.6，cuDNN 9.5.0）上进行，每卡batch size为4，梯度累积8步。推理延迟测量在单张A100上执行，batch size=1，input length=2048。延迟降低比例的计算公式为：1 - (latency_MRA / latency_Base)。Base为不做稀疏化的标准注意力。”

1. 背景与目标
近两周客服收到多条关于「航班可用性查询无结果」的投诉，日均约 12 条。经初步分析，疑似航班数据同步链路存在延迟，导致查询返回空。本需求目标：将 `/api/v1/flight/availability` 接口的同步周期从 5 分钟缩短至 30 秒，以提升余票可见性。

2. 具体改动
2.1 数据同步任务 `sync_flight_avail` 的 cron 由 `*/5 * * * *` 改为 `*/30 * * * * *`。
2.2 增加同步失败重试 3 次，退避 1s / 5s / 15s。
2.3 接口超时时间从 2000ms 调整为 2500ms。
3. 验收标准
3.1 同步任务平均延迟 < 30s。
3.2 航班可用性查询空结果率 < 0.1%。
3.3 不再收到同类投诉。

【用户提问】
I want you to act as a travel guide for a trip to a new city. Please provide brief and concise information about the must-visit tourist destinations, local culture and customs, and any other relevant information. Do not provide personal opinions or recommendations. Your response should be limited to facts and information.
<extra_id_1>Assistant
Great! Let’s start by telling me about the type of travelers you’re traveling with, so that I can make recommendations appropriate for your group.
<extra_id_1>User
We are a family taking children out for tourism.

【模型回答】
Sure, here are some tips for a great family trip to a new city:
 

 1. Choose kid-friendly activities: Look for attractions and activities that will be fun for both adults and children. Try to include activities that cater to different age groups to keep everyone entertained.
 

 2. Plan ahead: Research and plan your itinerary beforehand, including the locations and approximate time required at each stop. This will help you make the most of your time and avoid wasting it on activities that may not be suitable for your family.
 

 3. Take breaks: Kids get tired easily, so make sure to schedule in breaks for rest and relaxation. This will also give you a chance to recharge and explore the city's local culture.
 

 4. Make it educational: Turn the trip into a learning experience by incorporating history, culture, and geography lessons into your itinerary. Many museums have educational programs and activities specifically designed for kids.
 

 5. Pack wisely: Make sure to pack all necessary items for your kids, such as snacks, water bottles, sunscreen, and any medications. It's also a good idea to bring a small first-aid kit in case of minor injuries.
 

 6. Be flexible: Remember that plans sometimes change, especially when traveling with kids. Be prepared to be flexible, and don't be too hard on yourself if plans don't go as expected.
 

 7. Have fun: Most importantly, enjoy the experience and make memories with your family. Take plenty of photos and share them with your loved ones back home to capture the moments and keep them close.
 

 Here are a few suggestions for kid-friendly activities in a new city:
 

 1. Visit a park or botanical garden: These spaces offer plenty of room to run around and explore, and many also have playgrounds and other kid-friendly amenities.
 

 2. Explore a museum: Many museums have interactive exhibits and activities specifically designed for kids. This is a great way to educate your children while also having fun.
 

 3. Take a city tour: Look for tours that are tailored to families and include kid-friendly activities. This can be a great way to learn about the city's history and culture while keeping your children engaged.
 

 4. Go to a zoo or aquarium: These venues offer an opportunity to see fascinating animals and learn about different habitats and ecosystems.
 

 5. Visit a science center: Science centers are designed to be interactive and engaging, with exhibits that encourage hands-on exploration and learning.
 

 6. Take a stroll through a historic district: Many cities have historic districts that can be a great way to educate your children about the city's past. Walk around and look at the old buildings, and stop to read the historical markers or take a guided tour.
 

 7. Visit a local market: Local markets are a great place to see and try new things, whether it's fresh produce, handmade crafts, or street food. This can be a fun and interactive way to introduce your children to new flavors and cultural experiences.
 

 Remember to also make the most of your time by planning ahead and choosing activities that are appropriate for your children's age and interests. And most importantly, have fun and make memories with your family!

Decolonization in Africa was a complex and multifaceted process that involved a range of political, social, and economic factors. The struggle for independence was often marked by violence and conflict, as African nationalists sought to free themselves from the grip of European colonial powers.

In North Africa, the French were forced out after a long and bloody war in Algeria. The conflict began in 1954 with a revolt by Algerian nationalists, which was brutally repressed by the French. The war escalated over the next eight years, with atrocities committed on both sides and heavy civilian casualties. In 1962, Algeria finally achieved independence, but the cost was high, with an estimated 1.5 million people killed in the conflict.

In sub-Saharan Africa, the struggle for independence was also marked by violence and conflict. In Ghana (formerly the Gold Coast), Kwame Nkrumah led the nationalist movement and became the country's first president in 1957. In Kenya, the Mau Mau rebellion was a violent uprising by the Kikuyu people against British colonial rule. The British responded with brutal force, killing thousands of Africans and detaining many more in concentration camps. Despite the violence, Kenya eventually gained independence in 1963.

The struggle for independence in Africa was often complicated by a range of factors, including economic instability, political divisions, and the legacy of colonial rule. Many African countries struggled to establish stable governments and build strong economies in the years following independence. Nevertheless, the end of colonial rule marked a new era for Africa, one in which Africans could finally determine their own destinies and build their own futures.

【用户提问】
Can one use Bayesian Networks to work with cyclic graphs and sequences of variable length?

【模型回答】
Yes, Bayesian networks can be used to work with cyclic graphs and sequences of variable length, but it requires some modifications to the traditional structure of Bayesian networks.

Cyclic graphs in Bayesian networks can be handled using a technique called "backward induction." This involves starting with the variable that is most dependent on other variables and working backwards through the cycle to determine the conditional probabilities of each variable given the other variables in the cycle. However, this can be computationally expensive and may not always be feasible for large cycles.

Working with sequences of variable length in Bayesian networks can be achieved using a technique called "dynamic Bayesian networks." In this approach, the network structure and conditional probability distributions are updated dynamically as new data is observed. This allows the network to learn and adapt to sequences of different lengths, and to handle missing data or variable-length sequences of observations.

However, it's important to note that both of these techniques can become computationally expensive and may not be feasible for large networks or datasets. Additionally, the use of cyclic graphs and dynamic Bayesian networks can make the interpretation of results more challenging.

【论文摘要】
标题：基于多源遥感与算力日志的生成式人工智能对自然环境影响的量化评估
作者：刘承宇、D. 帕特尔、何静
投稿编号：ENVSCI-2024-0873
摘要：本研究构建了一套跨层耦合模型，将全球主要AI数据中心的算力消耗日志与环境遥感指标直接对齐，首次实现生成式AI对森林覆盖、水体浊度与大气PM2.5的季度级因果推断。基于2021Q1至2023Q4共12个季度的观测，我们发现AI算力每增长1 PFLOP-日，区域归一化植被指数（NDVI）平均下降0.0073（95%CI：-0.0091至-0.0055），水体浊度上升2.1 NTU，PM2.5上升0.9 µg/m³。模型在高纬度地区解释力R²=0.81，结论稳健。我们据此建议对超大规模模型训练实施环境补偿配额。

【方法段（节选）】
2.1 算力日志来源：采用第三方算力监测平台提供的公开GPU集群日粒度功耗记录，覆盖北美、北欧、东亚共31个站点，时间范围2021-01-01T00:00:00Z至2023-12-31T23:59:59Z。
2.2 环境指标：NDVI取自MODIS MOD13Q1产品（16天合成，250 m）；水体浊度取自站点的原位浊度计，采样间隔15 min；PM2.5取自各站点50 km内EPA/EEA等效监测站。
2.3 时间对齐策略：算力日志原始时间戳为UTC，环境遥感产品标注本地时间，为统一尺度，将算力日志的UTC时间**减去8小时**转换为“本地工作日”后再与季度均值对齐。
2.4 因果识别：采用双向固定效应面板回归，站点与季度双固定，聚类稳健标准误；以站点前一年同期算力增长作为工具变量。
2.5 控制变量：GDP、人口密度、站点所在国数据中心总数、季度平均气温。

【审稿意见（审稿人2）】
稿件ENVSCI-2024-0873
总体评价：选题重要，写作流畅。然而，核心结论可能被数据处理中的一个不易察觉的问题系统性夸大。请作者重点核查以下三点：
(1) 方法2.3的时间转换方向。稿件称将算力日志UTC“减去8小时”与遥感季度均值对齐，但季度均值对±8小时的偏移应近似不敏感；真正敏感的是**周内对齐**。请作者说明为何选择减8而非保留单一基准。
(2) 摘要报告NDVI下降0.0073，而附件Table S3中同口径效应为-0.0072~-0.0074，量级一致，但请说明该量级是否超出MODIS NDVI 16天合成的随机噪声底（通常约±0.005）。
(3) 图4显示2022Q2 NDVI残差异常低，请确认该季度是否存在资料缺失或烧除异常。
建议：大修。

[2024-10-14T17:05:44Z] 结论：主回归系数数值可复现；时间对齐方向对季度均值结果不敏感（r=0.99993）；2022Q2为观测缺失期，剔除后效应降至-0.00602；效应/噪声比约1.43。

【用户提问】
The future of programming relies on the unification of data and program into a single entity

【模型回答】
The idea that the future of programming lies in the unification of data and program into a single entity is a concept that has been gaining traction in the programming community in recent years. This idea, known as "data-driven programming," is based on the notion that data is the primary unit of computation, and that programs should be designed to manipulate and process data in a flexible and dynamic way.

In a data-driven programming model, data is treated as a first-class citizen, and programs are constructed by composing data transformations and operations. This approach has several advantages over traditional programming models, including increased flexibility, improved maintainability, and reduced complexity.

One of the key benefits of data-driven programming is its ability to simplify complex problems. By breaking down a problem into its constituent parts and expressing those parts as data transformations, it becomes easier to reason about and debug the solution. This approach also allows for greater reuse and sharing of code, as data transformations can be composed and reused in multiple contexts.

Another advantage of data-driven programming is its flexibility. Because data is the primary unit of computation, it can be easily manipulated and transformed to fit the needs of a particular application. This flexibility allows developers to quickly adapt to changing requirements and to build applications that are scalable and adaptable to new situations.

Finally, data-driven programming can also lead to improved maintainability. By separating the data from the logic that processes it, it becomes easier to understand and modify the behavior of an application. This approach also allows for easier testing and debugging, as data transformations can be tested in isolation from the rest of the application.

While data-driven programming has many benefits, it also presents some challenges. One of the key challenges is the need for a deep understanding of data structures and algorithms. In a data-driven programming model, it is essential to have a strong understanding of how data is structured and how it can be manipulated to achieve the desired results. This requires a significant investment in learning and mastering data structures and algorithms, which can be a barrier for some developers.

Another challenge of data-driven programming is the need for careful design and planning. Because data is the primary unit of computation, it is essential to carefully consider the structure of the data and how it will be used in the application. This requires a deep understanding of the problem domain and the data that is being used, and can be a significant challenge for developers who are used to working with more traditional programming models.

Despite these challenges, data-driven programming is a promising approach that has the potential to revolutionize the way we build software applications. By treating data as the primary unit of computation, we can build more flexible, maintainable, and scalable applications that are better suited to the needs of modern applications. As we continue to evolve our programming models and tools, it is likely that data-driven programming will become an increasingly important part of the software development landscape.

标题：基于情感配对模型的在线约会标语自动生成
作者：P. N. 陈，L. 吴

摘要：
本文提出一种情感配对模型（Affect-Matching Transformer, AMT），为在线约会网站自动生成个性化标语。在 DATING-SLOGAN-6K 数据集上，AMT 在人类评分（1–5 分流畅度与吸引力）上达到 4.31±0.06，相较基线模板法（3.88±0.09）提升 0.43 分。我们宣称该方法可实时部署于生产环境，单条标语生成延迟低于 100 ms。

方法段：
我们采用 8 层 Transformer，隐藏维度 512，训练数据为 DATING-SLOGAN-6K。训练硬件：1×NVIDIA A100 80GB。推理延迟在 A100 上测得 42 ms/条。文中表 3 注明：所有对比实验均在搭载 NVMe SSD 的服务器上完成，脚本使用 PyTorch 2.1.0 + CUDA 12.1。

How to use chatGPT to improve the quality of medical record

Introduction

In the field of medicine, accurate and detailed medical records are essential for providing quality patient care. However, the process of creating and maintaining medical records can be time-consuming and laborious, especially for healthcare providers who are already overwhelmed with a high volume of patients. In this context, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools such as chatGPT can help to streamline the medical record-keeping process and improve the quality of medical records.

chatGPT is a natural language processing (NLP) tool that uses machine learning algorithms to process and understand human language. It can be used to automate tasks such as data entry, document classification, and information retrieval. In the context of medical record-keeping, chatGPT can be used to automatically populate medical records with patient information, such as demographics, medical history, and laboratory results.

In this proposal, we will discuss how chatGPT can be used to improve the quality of medical records and streamline the medical record-keeping process.

Methodology

chatGPT can be integrated with existing medical record-keeping systems to automate the process of populating medical records with patient information. The integration process can be achieved through the use of APIs or other software development tools.

Once integrated with the medical record-keeping system, chatGPT can be trained to recognize and understand the structure and format of medical records. This training process can be achieved through the use of labeled data sets or other machine learning techniques.

Once trained, chatGPT can be used to automatically populate medical records with patient information. This can be achieved by using natural language queries to retrieve information from other sources, such as electronic health records (EHRs) or laboratory databases.

chatGPT can also be used to automate the process of updating medical records with new information. For example, it can be used to automatically generate progress notes or discharge summaries based on the patient's medical history and current status.

In addition to automating the process of populating and updating medical records, chatGPT can also be used to improve the quality of medical records by providing suggestions and recommendations based on the patient's medical history and current status. For example, it can suggest appropriate diagnostic tests or treatment options based on the patient's medical history and current symptoms.

Benefits

The use of chatGPT to improve the quality of medical records can bring several benefits, including:

Improved accuracy: chatGPT can help to reduce the risk of errors in medical records by automating the process of populating and updating medical records.

Reduced workload: The use of chatGPT can help to reduce the workload of healthcare providers by automating repetitive and time-consuming tasks such as data entry and information retrieval.

Improved efficiency: The use of chatGPT can help to improve the efficiency of the medical record-keeping process by reducing the time spent on manual data entry and information retrieval.

Improved patient care: The use of chatGPT can help to improve the quality of patient care by providing healthcare providers with access to accurate and up-to-date medical records.

Conclusion

In conclusion, the use of chatGPT to improve the quality of medical records can bring several benefits, including improved accuracy, reduced workload, improved efficiency, and improved patient care. The integration of chatGPT with existing medical record-keeping systems can help to streamline the medical record-keeping process and improve the quality of medical records.

【用户提问】
What are the benefits and challenges of using data analytics for credit scoring?

【模型回答】
Benefits of Using Data Analytics for Credit Scoring:

* **Accuracy:** Data analytics are often more accurate than other credit reporting methods.
* **Efficiency:** Data analytics is an automated credit scoring process. This ensures that scores are received faster which expedites the lending process.
* **Fraud Detection:** Data analytics makes it easy to detect Fraud by catching any abnormalities in credit applications.
* **Informed Decisions:** By assessing the risks associated with each borrower, lenders can make more informed decisions. 

Challenges of Using Data Analytics for Credit Scoring:

* **Privacy:** There are some privacy concerns about the large amount of personal data that gets collected for credit scoring.
* **Fairness**: There are times when data analytics incorporates biased information in the data. This can make it particularly difficult for marginalized groups to receive fair reports.
* **Quality:** It can be challenging to ensure that all of the data collected is quality. This leads to a significant impact when it comes to accuracy.

define blocking and non blocking I/O

【模型回答】
Blocking and non-blocking I/O are two different approaches to handling input/output (I/O) operations in computer programming.
 

 Blocking I/O is a type of I/O operation that blocks the execution of a program until the I/O operation is completed. This means that the program will wait for the I/O operation to finish before continuing with the next instruction. For example, if a program is reading data from a file, it will block until the data has been read and stored in memory.
 

 Non-blocking I/O, on the other hand, is a type of I/O operation that does not block the execution of a program. Instead, the program can continue with other tasks while the I/O operation is being performed. This allows the program to make progress even if the I/O operation takes a long time to complete.
 

 In general, blocking I/O is simpler to implement and use, but it can lead to performance issues if the I/O operation takes a long time to complete. Non-blocking I/O is more complex to implement, but it can provide better performance and scalability in certain situations, such as when handling multiple I/O operations simultaneously.

【Pull Request 描述】
PR #4821: feat(payment): 为 charge 接口增加幂等重试与退避
作者: @liang.hao (支付核心组)
目标分支: release/2024.09

背景：上周 2024-09-11T03:12:44Z 到 2024-09-11T03:41:08Z 之间，charge 接口 P99 从 420ms 涨到 2310ms，下游 PSP 返回 502 的比例从 0.3% 升到 6.8%。运维怀疑是我们的重试逻辑在放大下游压力。这个 PR 把重试从「固定 3 次、每次间隔 100ms」改成「指数退避 + 抖动」，并新增了熔断阈值。

改动点：
1. RetryPolicy 默认 maxAttempts 从 3 改为 5；
2. 退避基数 baseDelayMs 从 100 改为 200；
3. 新增 CircuitBreaker: 滑动窗口 10s 内失败率 > 50% 且请求数 >= 20 时打开，打开后 30s 半开；
4. HttpClient 的 readTimeout 从 3000ms 调整为 1500ms。

我本地压测（单实例，模拟 PSP 500 错误率 30%）P99 是 1780ms，比改动前的 2260ms 明显改善，所以这个改动应该能缓解线上问题。请帮忙 review，谢谢。

@@ -18,9 +18,11 @@ public class RetryPolicy {
-    public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;
-    public static final long DEFAULT_BASE_DELAY_MS = 100L;
+    public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
+    public static final long DEFAULT_BASE_DELAY_MS = 200L;
+    public static final long MAX_DELAY_MS = 2000L;
 
-    public long delayFor(int attempt) {
-        return DEFAULT_BASE_DELAY_MS * (long) Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
+    public long delayFor(int attempt) {
+        long d = DEFAULT_BASE_DELAY_MS * (long) Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
+        return Math.min(d, MAX_DELAY_MS);
     }
 }

@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@ public class HttpClientConfig {
-    private Duration readTimeout = Duration.ofMillis(3000);
+    private Duration readTimeout = Duration.ofMillis(1500);
     private Duration connectTimeout = Duration.ofMillis(500);
 }

There are many backend frameworks that you can use to build a web application, each with their own pros and cons. Here are some popular options:

1. Ruby on Rails: Pros - Ruby on Rails is a mature and popular framework that offers a lot of features and a large community of developers. It has a convention-over-configuration approach that makes it easy to get started, and it includes built-in support for many features like authentication and authorization. Cons - Ruby on Rails can be slower than other frameworks, and it can be difficult to scale complex applications.

2. Django: Pros - Django is another popular and mature framework that offers many features and a large community of developers. It has a strong focus on security and includes built-in support for features like authentication and authorization. Cons - Django can be more difficult to learn than some other frameworks, and it can be difficult to customize some aspects of the framework.

3. Flask: Pros - Flask is a lightweight and flexible framework that is easy to learn and customize. It is fast and scalable, and it offers a lot of flexibility in terms of how you structure your application. Cons - Flask is a minimalist framework that does not offer as many features out of the box as some other frameworks. You will need to add additional libraries and components to get some of the functionality that is built into other frameworks.

4. Node.js: Pros - Node.js is a popular framework for building real-time applications and APIs. It is fast and scalable, and it offers a lot of flexibility in terms of how you structure your application. Cons - Node.js can be more difficult to learn than some other frameworks, and it can be more difficult to debug and maintain complex applications.

5. Spring: Pros - Spring is a popular Java-based framework that offers many features and a large community of developers. It is fast and scalable, and it includes built-in support for many features like authentication and authorization. Cons - Spring can be more difficult to learn than some other frameworks, and it can be difficult to customize some aspects of the framework.

【投稿材料 MANU-2026-0317（节选）】

标题：基于便携脑电的学龄儿童持续注意时长预测模型：一项课堂场景研究

摘要：持续注意（sustained attention）是课堂学习的前提。既往研究表明，注意力不集中的儿童往往难以在长时段任务中维持稳定表现。本研究招募 62 名 7–10 岁儿童，采集其在校完成持续操作任务（Sustained Attention to Response Task, SART）期间的 4 通道前额脑电（采样率 256 Hz，带通 0.5–45 Hz），并记录每位儿童连续完成任务的时长（单位：秒）。我们提出一种轻量卷积网络，以 30 秒滑窗脑电片段为输入，预测该儿童的持续注意时长。十折交叉验证结果显示，模型预测值与真实时长的皮尔逊相关系数 r = 0.81（p < 0.001），平均绝对误差 MAE = 42.6 秒。结论：便携脑电可用于课堂场景下的儿童持续注意时长评估。

方法（节选）：
3.2 数据采集。全部数据采集于 2025 年 9 月 8 日至 2025 年 11 月 21 日完成，地点为南京市某小学两间安静教室。每名儿童在单一session内完成 SART，随后立即由主试记录其持续注意时长（SART 中连续正确反应的最长时段）。原始脑电经 0.5–45 Hz 带通滤波、50 Hz 陷波，去除眼动与肌电伪迹（ICA，剔除成分数中位数 2）。
3.3 数据划分。为充分利用数据，我们对全部 62 名儿童的全部滑窗样本进行随机十折划分：随机将 12400 个 30 秒滑窗分为十份，每次取九份训练、一份验证，重复十次取平均。此做法可保证训练集与验证集样本量均衡。
3.4 标签。每位儿童的标签为其个人持续注意时长（秒），同一儿童的多个滑窗共享同一标签。

§1.1 被保险人：本合同所指被保险人以投保单载明并经核保通过者为准。
§2.1 保险期间：自保单生效时间零时起，至约定终止日二十四时止。
§2.7 保险费及宽限期：分期缴付保险费的，到期未缴且逾宽限期（自应缴日次日起 60 日）仍未缴付的，本合同自宽限期届满日的次日零时起效力中止；效力中止期间发生的保险事故，本公司不承担给付责任。

§5.1 住院日额：以入院日至出院日的实际住院天数计，每日 2,100 元，不足一日按一日计。

【PR 描述 · 人写】
提交人：@lizhi（后端组）
标题：fix: 为 /api/v2/recommend 加 300 秒本地缓存，降低 P99 延迟
描述：
这个 PR 把 recommendation service 里对向量库的查询结果缓存 300 秒。最近 P99 实在太高了（昨晚告警到 2.3 秒），我加了本地 LRU 缓存，TTL=300s，容量 1000 条。本地跑压测命中率能到 92%，P99 从 2.1s 掉到 640ms。这个改动风险很低，只动了 recommend.py 一个文件，没有改数据库和下游协议。恳请尽快合并，线上已经在烧了。

【diff 片段 · 机器产生】
--- a/service/recommend.py
+++ b/service/recommend.py
@@ -14,6 +14,9 @@
 import time
+CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 300
+CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES = 1000
+
@@ -88,7 +91,13 @@ def get_recommendations(user_id, region):
-    rows = vector_store.query(user_id, top_k=50)
+    cache_key = f"rec:{user_id}"
+    if cache_key in _local_cache and time.time() - _local_cache[cache_key][0] < CACHE_TTL_SECONDS:
+        rows = _local_cache[cache_key][1]
+    else:
+        rows = vector_store.query(user_id, top_k=50)
+        _local_cache[cache_key] = (time.time(), rows)
     return rank(rows, region)

+        Boolean locked = redisTemplate.opsForValue().setIfAbsent(lockKey, "1", 3000, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);

【用户提问】
is there a equivalent to power through a resistor for flow in a pipe?

【模型回答】
Yes, there is an equivalent to power through a resistor for flow in a pipe. In fluid dynamics, the term used is "head loss" or "pressure drop."

Just as electrical resistance opposes the flow of electrical current, pipes and components in a fluid system also provide resistance to the flow of fluid. This resistance results in a loss of pressure as the fluid flows through the system.

The head loss or pressure drop in a fluid system is calculated using the Darcy-Weisbach equation, which takes into account the fluid density, flow velocity, pipe diameter, and a friction factor that depends on the roughness of the pipe and the Reynolds number of the flow.

In fluid power systems, the pressure drop across a component, such as a valve or a filter, is often referred to as the "pressure loss." This loss in pressure is analogous to the voltage drop across an electrical resistor, and it results in a reduction in the available energy to perform work.

Therefore, in fluid systems, the pressure drop or head loss serves as an equivalent to the power dissipated by a resistor in an electrical circuit.

第六条 保险责任
在保险期间内，因下列原因造成保险标的的直接物质损坏，保险人按约定负责赔偿：
（一）火灾、爆炸；
（二）雷击、暴雨、洪水；
（三）空中运行物体坠落；
（四）被保险人居所内因意外事故导致的财产损失。

《便携设备意外损坏附加条款（2023版）》
第二条 承保范围
本附加条款承保被保险人所有或租用的便携式电子设备（含数码相机、笔记本电脑、手机等）因突发、非故意的意外事故造成的损坏。
第四条 责任免除
下列损失，保险人不负责赔偿：
（一）设备自然磨损、腐蚀、氧化、锈蚀；
（二）设备因跌落、碰撞导致的屏幕、镜头、外壳等外观部件损坏；
（三）被保险人故意行为或重大过失造成的损失；
（四）设备在维修、保养、改装过程中发生的损坏。
第五条 免赔与限额
每次事故绝对免赔额500元；同一保险年度内累计赔付以保额20000元为限。

【用户提问】
I need to develop my fluency in English - German is my first language. I am a b2 learner. I find it hard to participate in group situations. Give me conversation strategies. Tell me differences and contrasts with German conversation norms. Give me a variety of conversation gambits to ask for and give clarification and provide a gap fill exercise for me to practise these. Do not give me the answers until I ask for them.

【模型回答】
Here are some strategies to help you improve your fluency in English and overcome your difficulty in participating in group situations:

1. Practice active listening: In a group conversation, it's important to actively listen to what others are saying and respond appropriately. This means paying attention to what others are saying, asking questions, and providing relevant comments.

2. Use open-ended questions: Open-ended questions are questions that cannot be answered with a simple "yes" or "no." They encourage deeper and more interesting conversations. For example, instead of asking "Do you like reading books?" ask "What kind of books do you like to read?"

3. Practice active participation: Try to actively participate in conversations by contributing your thoughts, ideas, and experiences. This will help you feel more comfortable and confident in group situations.

4. Focus on one person at a time: When speaking with multiple people, try to focus on one person at a time and have a conversation with them. This will help you feel less overwhelmed and more in control of the conversation.

5. Use clear and concise language: When speaking in a group, it's important to use clear and concise language so that everyone can understand you. Speak slowly and clearly, and avoid using jargon or technical terms that may confuse others.

6. Practice with a partner: Find a language exchange partner or a friend who speaks English as a second language and practice having conversations with them. This will help you build your confidence and improve your fluency.

Here are some differences and contrasts between English and German conversation norms:

1. Turn-taking: In English, it's common for multiple people to speak at once, while in German, it's more common for one person to speak at a time.

2. Eye contact: In English, it's common to make direct eye contact during a conversation, while in German, it's more common to avoid direct eye contact.

3. Personal space: In English, it's common to stand close to the person you're speaking with, while in German, it's more common to maintain a bit more distance.

4. Small talk: In English, it's common to engage in small talk to start a conversation, while in German, it's more common to get straight to the point.

Here's a gap fill exercise to help you practice asking for and giving clarification:

1. If you're not sure what someone is saying, you can ask them to __ (slow down/ speak more clearly/ repeat what they said).
2. If you need more information about something, you can ask questions like " __ (What/ How/ Where/ When/ Why) __?"
3. If you're having trouble understanding a word or phrase, you can ask for a __ (synonym/ explanation/ translation).
4. If you make a mistake, it's important to __ (acknowledge it/ correct it) __ so that the conversation can move forward.
5. If you want to emphasize a point, you can use __ (gestures/ facial expressions/ tone of voice) __ to help convey your message.

Remember to practice these strategies and conversation gambits regularly to improve your fluency in English and feel more comfortable in group situations.

【论文节选｜PAPER-2047】
=== 摘要 ===
本文提出 DiceGame-Bench，一个覆盖 32 种骰子游戏变体的问答基准。我们证明，即使不人为加入高斯噪声，模型依然能达到 94% 以上的 top-1 命中率，刷新 SOTA。

=== 方法段 M3.2 ===
（原文条款 M3.2 一）“默认推理路径适用”仅当字典 D 初始化时 β=0.5，方可声明无需噪声模块的稳态。
（条款 M3.2 二）只有在解析依赖满足 Python>=3.11 时，noiseboost 注入模块才随主流程加载；若解析器降级至 Python 3.10，该模块强制跳过并回退至 β=0.5 基准线。

【模型回答】
The relationship between speed, lateral acceleration, and curvature is an important concept in vehicle dynamics and road safety. Here's an intuitive explanation for why speed is often expressed as a function of lateral acceleration and curvature:

Lateral acceleration: When a vehicle turns, the force of gravity acting on the vehicle causes it to experience a force perpendicular to its direction of travel, known as lateral acceleration. This force acts on the vehicle's center of gravity and is proportional to the vehicle's speed and the curvature of the turn.

Curvature: Curvature refers to the amount that a path deviates from a straight line. In the context of vehicle dynamics, it is often measured as the inverse of the radius of the circular arc that approximates the path of the vehicle through a turn. The larger the curvature, the tighter the turn and the smaller the radius of the circular arc.

Speed: Speed is a key factor in determining the lateral acceleration experienced by a vehicle. As the speed of the vehicle increases, the lateral acceleration also increases, making the turn more challenging to negotiate. Conversely, as the speed of the vehicle decreases, the lateral acceleration also decreases, making the turn easier to navigate.

The relationship between speed, lateral acceleration, and curvature can be expressed as a mathematical formula: speed = lateral acceleration / curvature. This formula states that the speed of a vehicle through a turn is proportional to the lateral acceleration experienced by the vehicle, divided by the curvature of the turn.

In an intuitive sense, this relationship can be understood as follows: the harder a vehicle is accelerating laterally (i.e., the greater the lateral acceleration), the faster it will be able to negotiate a turn, assuming the same curvature. Conversely, a vehicle traveling at a higher speed will experience greater lateral acceleration and will need to navigate a turn with a larger radius (i.e., lower curvature) in order to avoid skidding or losing control.

This relationship is important for drivers to understand, as it can help them determine how fast they can safely navigate a turn, given the road conditions and their vehicle's capabilities. By knowing the curvature of a turn and the lateral acceleration their vehicle is experiencing, drivers can calculate the maximum safe speed through the turn, using the formula above. This can help prevent accidents and improve road safety.

【稿件】投稿编号：SOC-2024-1187｜题目：《监控装置密度与社会信任的相关性：来自163个城市的证据》｜投稿时间：2024-03-02T09:14:00+08:00

摘要：本文收集了163个城市的监控摄像头密度数据（台/千人，均值4.7，标准差1.9），并与社会信任问卷得分（0-100）进行回归。结果显示，监控密度每提高1台/千人，社会信任下降2.3分（p<0.01）。我们据此主张：监控扩张正在系统性地侵蚀社会信任。

方法段（节选）：城市层面社会信任得分来自2021年世界价值观调查（WVS）第7波的子样本；监控摄像头密度来自2022年各城市公安年报统计。两者在时间上不完全对齐。控制变量包括人均GDP、失业率和城市化率。样本量N=163。

【审稿意见】审稿人1：作者提出的机制过于强健，摘要中使用"系统性侵蚀"的因果用语不妥；方法段仅以"时间不完全对齐"一句带过，未做敏感性分析。建议大修。审稿人2：相关系数方向与既有文献一致，可接收，但需补充因果讨论。

There are several areas of opportunity for a new company looking to compete against established players like CarMax, CarGurus, and AutoTrader:

1. Innovation: A new company can differentiate itself by offering innovative features and services that set it apart from the competition. This could include a unique user experience, advanced search and filtering capabilities, or new ways of connecting buyers and sellers.

2. Niche focus: A new company can also target a specific niche within the automotive market, such as electric vehicles, luxury cars, or off-road vehicles. By focusing on a specific niche, a new company can establish itself as a specialist and attract a dedicated customer base.

3. Price: A new company can compete on price by offering more competitive rates to sellers or buyers, or by finding ways to reduce costs and pass the savings on to customers.

4. Marketing: A new company can invest heavily in marketing and advertising to build brand awareness and attract customers. This could include digital marketing, social media campaigns, and traditional advertising.

5. Customer service: A new company can prioritize customer service and build a reputation for exceptional support and care. This could include offering extended hours, personalized service, and a commitment to resolving customer issues quickly and effectively.

In summary, a new company looking to compete against established players in the automotive market should focus on innovation, niche focus, price, marketing, and customer service to establish itself as a viable alternative and attract customers.

 2. Address chronic pain: Since chronic pain can lead to opioid addiction, it is important to address the underlying cause of the pain. This may involve physical therapy, pain management techniques, or other treatments to help reduce the individual's pain levels.

This may include cognitive-behavioral therapy, which helps individuals identify and change negative thinking patterns and behaviors, or family therapy, which can help the individual's loved ones understand and support their recovery.
 

 4. Support groups: Joining a support group can provide the individual with a community of people who are going through similar struggles. This can help them feel less alone and provide them with encouragement and support during their recovery journey.
 

 5. Monitor medication: If the individual is prescribed medication to help manage their addiction, it is important to monitor their use to ensure that they are taking it as prescribed and not abusing it.
 

 It is important to approach the individual with compassion and understanding and to involve them in the decision-making process when it comes to their treatment. With the right support and resources, individuals with fentanyl addiction can recover and lead fulfilling lives.

【用户提问】
You are an amazing teacher who can write content that kids enjoy reading, find entertaining, and learns from easily. You explain complex topics simply and in a way kids can understand. You write creatively and in a fun yet informational tone while teaching the different concepts. You are writing to a group of 3rd grades who love and are eager to learn social studies. 
The main focus of the passage you are creating is this: Natural hazards are events which happen in the physical environment and are not necessarily predictable. Natural hazards include hurricanes, earthquakes, tornadoes, tsunamis, droughts, volcanoes, fires, floods, and insect infestations. Natural hazards are characterized by the damage they cause to property and people.
Write about what natural hazards are and with each type of natural hazard explain what it is and give an example or anecdote or story. 
I want you to write an fun, entertaining passage that teaches these concepts to 3rd graders.  Create a creative title for the passage as well. Don't refer to yourself in the passage. 

【模型回答】
Title: Nature's Wild Side: Understanding Natural Hazards

Have you ever been caught in a sudden rainstorm that flooded the streets? Or maybe you felt the ground shake during an earthquake. These are examples of natural hazards, which are events that happen in the physical environment and can cause damage to property and harm to people.

Natural hazards include hurricanes, earthquakes, tornadoes, tsunamis, droughts, volcanoes, fires, floods, and insect infestations. Let's take a closer look at each one!

Hurricanes are powerful storms that form over warm ocean waters and bring heavy rain, high winds, and flooding. One of the most famous hurricanes in history was Hurricane Katrina, which devastated the Gulf Coast of the United States in 2005.

Earthquakes are caused by the movement of tectonic plates beneath the Earth's surface. They can cause buildings to collapse, landslides, and tsunamis. One of the most powerful earthquakes in recent history was the 2010 earthquake in Haiti, which killed over 200,000 people.

Tornadoes are rotating columns of air that form during thunderstorms. They can cause devastating damage to buildings and infrastructure. One of the most famous tornadoes in history was the one that hit the town of Joplin, Missouri in 2011, killing over 160 people.

Tsunamis are large waves that can be caused by earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, or even landslides. They can cause flooding and damage to coastal areas. One of the most famous tsunamis in history was the one that hit Japan in 2011, killing over 15,000 people.

Droughts are long periods of time with little or no rainfall. They can cause water shortages, crop failures, and wildfires. One of the most severe droughts in recent history was the one that hit California in 2012, which led to water restrictions and wildfires.

Volcanoes are mountains that are made up of hardened lava and ash. They can erupt and spew lava, ash, and toxic gases into the air. One of the most famous volcanoes in history was Mount Vesuvius, which erupted in 79 AD and destroyed the city of Pompeii.

Fires are uncontrolled burns that can spread quickly and cause damage to property and harm to people. They can be caused by lightning, human activity, or even accidents. One of the most famous fires in recent history was the California wildfires of 2018, which killed over 80 people and destroyed thousands of homes.

Insect infestations are when large numbers of insects, such as locusts or termites, invade an area and cause damage to crops or buildings. One of the most famous insect infestations in history was the locust plague that hit Africa in the 1930s, which caused widespread famine and death.

Natural hazards can be scary, but it's important to understand them and be prepared for them. By learning about the different types of natural hazards and their effects, we can better protect ourselves and our communities. So let's keep exploring Nature's Wild Side!

state: 2024年9月12日晚，林悦在小区二手闲置群发了转让捷安特Escape 1公路车的消息，配了官网详情页截图：「2023年款，8速变速，铝合金车架，适合10公里内日常通勤，原价2998，自用1年，因换公司骑车距离太远转卖，一口价1200，车况良好无硬伤」。群里同楼的周凯当即私信问：「我每天从家到地铁站骑8公里，刚好需要这么辆车，明天能看成色吗？」林悦秒回：「没问题，车就在单元楼停车棚，今晚锁着的，你要是信得过我，我把之前拍的几张实物图发你。」9月13日中午周凯趁午休去停车棚看车，绕车检查时拍了4张照片，在车把的磨损印记旁发现车架下管贴的原厂铭牌印着2022年8月出厂，顺着链条转动的方向试骑了3米，右后飞轮卡了三颗牙，变速拨到3档时链条直接蹭到相邻的4档齿片。他翻林悦昨天发的实物图，图里刻意避开了下管铭牌和后飞轮的位置，光线打在车架表面看不到掉漆。周凯给林悦发消息：「你之前说这是2023年款、8速变速没问题、车况良好无硬伤，但我看到的车是2022年出厂的，后飞轮有三颗卡齿，3档变速蹭链啊。」林悦半小时后回：「哦那是上周下雨溅的泥堵了齿片，我明天帮你调一下变速肯定就好，价格还能给你减50，你要是诚心要我今晚就把车洗干净给你看全貌。」周凯盯着聊天记录皱了眉，他想起自己上个月同事在群里收同型号车，2022年款、变速顺畅无暗病的同款才卖1100。

王倩你好，绩效委员会的各位好：

我对Q2绩效评定结果不能接受。我的终评是2.8分，落在“待改进”区间，直接导致本季度绩效奖金归零并触发PIP预警。

问题集中在三点：
第一，罗铭在评价里说我“Q2多次未按公司要求到岗，考勤异常达5次，团队协作响应迟缓”。但实际上我Q2有大量时间是应客户要求在外地驻场，项目组包括我共4人常驻上海客户现场。我不可能在南京总部打卡，这属于差旅，不是缺勤。
第二，说我“响应迟缓”。我翻遍IM记录，客户现场的网络到晚上才稳定，我几乎每晚10点后都在回消息、改方案。如果只看白天9点到18点的在线状态，当然显得我“不活跃”。
第三，我被扣了3天年假折算的考勤款，依据是《员工考勤与外出管理办法》第7.2条考勤异常达5次启动扣款。我认为这5次里至少有3次是我的外出登记被漏审，不该算异常。

我要求：复核Q2考勤记录、撤回扣款、把绩效从2.8改回3.5分以上。我Q2主导交付的“启明”项目是按时上线的，客户满意度回访是9.2分（满分10）。

【论文摘要与方法段】
标题：基于多模态步态融合的帕金森病早期筛查模型
作者：李明、陈思远、王璐
单位：东南大学附属医院神经内科
摘要：本文提出一种融合可穿戴加速度计与足底压力传感器的帕金森病（PD）早期筛查模型。方法段：受试者佩戴六个惯性测量单元（IMU），采样率100Hz，每个步态周期截取0.8秒窗口。我们招募了62名受试者（PD组31人，对照组31人），采用留一法交叉验证，在公开数据集上取得准确率94.3%，F1分数0.921。

【审稿意见】
审稿人B（第3轮）：作者声称准确率94.3%，但复现时发现测试集划分存在数据泄露。建议作者公开原始时间戳与分组文件。另，方法段中'0.8秒窗口'与图2中标注的'1.0s window'矛盾，请澄清。
审稿人C（第2轮）：样本量62例，PD组平均年龄68.4±7.2岁，对照组平均年龄67.1±6.9岁，组间年龄无显著差异（p=0.42）。但对照组中2例有帕金森病家族史，应说明是否影响结论。

Sure, I can act as a product manager with 3 years of experience in tool products. Here are some steps I would take when managing a tool product:

1. Understand the market: I would conduct market research to identify the needs and pain points of our target customers. This would involve analyzing industry trends, customer feedback, and competitive products.
2. Define the product vision: Based on the market research, I would define a clear product vision that aligns with the needs of our customers and the goals of the business.
3. Set product goals: I would work with the product team to set specific, measurable, and attainable product goals that align with the product vision.
4. Develop a roadmap: I would create a product roadmap that outlines the key features and initiatives that will be delivered over time. The roadmap should be flexible and able to adapt to changing market conditions and customer needs.
5. Collaborate with cross-functional teams: I would work closely with engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to ensure that the product is developed and launched successfully.
6. Manage the product development process: I would oversee the product development process, ensuring that it is on time, on budget, and meets the quality standards of the business.
7. Collect and analyze feedback: I would actively collect and analyze customer feedback to identify areas for improvement and new features.
8. Measure success: I would use data and analytics to measure the success of the product and make data-driven decisions to improve it over time.
9. Stay up-to-date with industry trends: I would stay up-to-date with the latest trends and developments in the tool industry to ensure that our product remains competitive and relevant.

Overall, as a product manager with 3 years of experience in tool products, I would focus on delivering a product that meets the needs of our customers, aligns with the goals of the business, and stays competitive in the market over time.

【用户提问】
what are the best camera and lighting settings for YouTube when using the bmpcc 6k?

【模型回答】
The Blackmagic Pocket Cinema Camera 6K (BMPCC 6K) is a powerful camera that can deliver excellent results for YouTube content creation. Here are some general settings and recommendations for camera and lighting when using the BMPCC 6K for YouTube.

Camera Settings:

1. Video Mode: Set the camera to Blackmagic RAW or ProRes 422 HQ for the best quality and flexibility in post-production. Blackmagic RAW offers higher quality and more latitude in color grading, but it requires more processing power. ProRes 422 HQ offers a good balance between quality and file size.
2. Resolution: Shoot in 6K if you need the extra resolution for cropping or stabilization. Otherwise, shoot in 4K or even 1080p for better compatibility with lower-resolution displays and a smaller file size.
3. Frame Rate: For most YouTube content, 24fps or 30fps will be sufficient. Use 60fps or higher for slow-motion or fast-action shots.
4. ISO: Set the ISO to the native ISO of 400 or 3200 for the best image quality and dynamic range. Avoid using auto-ISO, as it can introduce noise and inconsistencies in the exposure.
5. Shutter Angle: A 180-degree shutter angle is standard for a natural motion blur and avoiding flickering.
6. White Balance: Set the white balance manually to match the color temperature of your lighting setup.

Lighting Settings:

1. Light Quality: Use soft, diffused light sources to reduce harsh shadows and evenly light the subject. Use softboxes, umbrellas, or diffusion panels to soften the light.
2. Light Position: Position the lights at a 45-degree angle from the subject to create a 3D effect. Use a key light, fill light, and backlight to create a three-point lighting setup.
3. Light Intensity: Adjust the light intensity to match the exposure of the camera and avoid overexposure or underexposure.
4. Light Color Temperature: Match the color temperature of the lights to the white balance of the camera to ensure accurate colors. Use lighting gels if necessary.
5. Lighting Ratio: Adjust the lighting ratio to create a more dramatic or subtle look. A higher lighting ratio creates more contrast and a more dramatic look, while a lower lighting ratio creates a more subtle and natural look.

Additional Tips:

1. Use a tripod or a stabilizer to ensure steady shots, especially when shooting in 6K.
2. Use a shotgun microphone or external recorder to capture high-quality audio.
3. Use false color or waveform monitors to help you adjust exposure and color balance.
4. Test your setup before shooting to ensure everything is working correctly.
5. Experiment with different settings and techniques to find the best look for your YouTube content.

顾总，就您提出的分组桶 hash 问题，我这边复算了 CL-20250716-2087 的下发逻辑：namespace badge_wall_v2 的 hash 取模用的是 user_id 的 murmur3，模 100 落在 0-9 的 10% 入 test，其余入 ctrl。我先自查了三个已知高活样本 U20013、U20311、U20314，均落在 0-9 桶，符合预期。但我在核对流水时发现一条容易被忽略的日志——2025-07-17T20:30:00 的 CL-20250717-2091 其实把 test 桶的埋点上报路径从旧 SDK 切成了新 SDK，这条变更没进 change 记录的主题，只写在了「圆角阴影溢出」的附注里：`side_effect: report_path_v1 -> report_path_v2`。这意味着 test 分群在 20:30 之前上报的事件，去重键算的是 SDK 批号，20:30 之后才算 user。前半夜的 UV 被压成了批次维度，看起来特别低。

另外 number 层面：附件-1 里 ctrl 的「徽章墙访问 UV 63,102」是 7 天累积去重的展示值（口径沿用 MC-2025-0711-03 之前的旧口径），test 那一列却是当日去重值，且两列的 watermark 虽都为 08:00，但 BI 缓存刷新在 08:05 已把 test 分流数据补成全量，ctrl 在 07:50 的第一次刷新就冻结了，第二次刷新没有覆盖 ctrl 的历史值。所以 41.2% 对 63.8% 这个对比本身不成立，不是分桶错，也不是 SDK 混报。

== 作者填写的 PR 描述（原文） ==
本次修复针对线上 P1 事故 INC-20250310-0417：支付回调在网关侧超时重试后，同一笔订单被重复入账两次。

根因分析：回调处理器 `notify_handler.go` 在处理 `PAY_SUCCESS` 事件时，仅依赖 `order_id` 做去重，但上游在 3 月 10 日灰度了新版本，重试时会生成新的 `event_id`，导致原去重失效。

本 PR 做了两件事：
1) 在 `notify_handler.go` 中新增幂等键 `idem_key = order_id + '_' + event_id`，并在 Redis 中做 SETNX 去重，TTL=86400s；
2) 将网关侧最大重试次数从 5 次收敛为 3 次（配置项 `pay.callback.max_retry`），减少重复窗口。

已在预发环境验证：连续投递同一 `event_id` 5 次，仅首次入账成功。

风险：低。仅影响支付回调链路，无 DB schema 变更。

== diff 片段（unified，节选，已省略无关行） ==
```diff
diff --git a/gateway/config/pay.yaml b/gateway/config/pay.yaml
@@ -41,7 +41,7 @@ pay:
   callback:
-    max_retry: 5
+    max_retry: 3
     retry_interval_ms: 200
     timeout_ms: 3000
```

```diff
diff --git a/pay/notify_handler.go b/pay/notify_handler.go
@@ -88,9 +88,14 @@ func (h *NotifyHandler) Handle(ctx context.Context, evt Event) error {
 	if evt.Type != PAY_SUCCESS {
 		return nil
 	}
-	key := evt.OrderID
+	// 幂等键：order_id + '_' + event_id
+	key := evt.OrderID + "_" + evt.EventID
 	if !h.redis.SetNX(ctx, key, 1, 86400*time.Second) {
 		return ErrDuplicate
 	}
```

The season also plays a critical role in coffee cultivation as it dictates the weather patterns from rainfall, temperature and enriching the soil. The top 5 soil types for coffee cultivation from January to April are:

1. Eastern region: the volcanic soil is fertile and rich in nutrients that support different coffee varieties.
2. Coastal region: sandy soil with good drainage favorable for nutrient retention.
3. Central region: mixed soil provides a balance of good drainage and moisture retention.
4. Highland region: loamy soil retaining moisture well with a cool temperature throughout the year.
5. Western region: has clayey soil holding nutrients but they need much attention because of their nature of getting waterlogged.

Depending on the coffee variety, the soil requirements could vary. Is it recommended to do a thorough study of the soil and its suitability for the variety it is targeted for.

【用户提问】
when planning solution architecture, which service should be synchronous and which asynchronous 

【模型回答】
The decision to use synchronous or asynchronous services in solution architecture depends on the specific requirements of the project. Here are some general guidelines:

Synchronous services:

Real-time communication: If the application requires real-time communication between two or more parties, then synchronous services are preferred. For example, a video conferencing application would require real-time communication between participants.

Critical transactions: If the success of a transaction is critical and cannot be delayed, then synchronous services are preferred. For example, online banking applications require immediate confirmation of transactions.

Asynchronous services:

Non-critical transactions: If the success of a transaction is not critical and can be delayed, then asynchronous services are preferred. For example, email and social media applications can send and receive messages at a later time.

Background processing: If the application requires background processing, such as data processing or batch processing, then asynchronous services are preferred. For example, an online shopping application can use asynchronous services to process orders in the background.

In general, it is important to carefully consider the requirements of the application and choose the appropriate services accordingly.

【论文摘要｜人写】
背景：选择性 5-羟色胺再摄取抑制剂（SSRI）与卒中风险的关联存在争议。方法：采用多中心回顾性队列，纳入 2015-01-01 至 2019-12-31 期间首发抑郁并随后暴露于 SSRI 的成人。排除既往脑血管事件、短暂性脑缺血发作及抗凝使用记录者。应用 Cox 比例风险模型，校正年龄、性别、高血压、糖尿病、Charlson 合并症指数和用药依从性。结果：校正后 HR=1.09（95% CI 1.04–1.14），绝对风险差 +0.7 例/1000 人年。结论：SSRI 使用与轻微升高的卒中风险相关，需进一步随机试验验证。

【方法段节选｜人写】
2.3 排除标准：protocol_v2 第 4.2 条规定，基线前 365 天内任意一处 ICD-10 编码 I60–I69、G45 或抗凝药 ATC B01A 记录均予排除。2.5 敏感性分析：我们平行比较 Charlson 指数与 Elixhauser 索引，主分析采用 Charlson，敏感性结果见补充表 S3。

【用户提问】
Describe the differences between the mechanisms of action in cognitive-behavioral and psychodynamic psychotherapies

【模型回答】
Cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) and psychodynamic therapy are two common types of psychotherapy that are used to treat a variety of mental health conditions. While both therapies aim to improve mental health and well-being, they differ in their underlying mechanisms of action.

In cognitive-behavioral therapy, the focus is on the relationship between thoughts, feelings, and behaviors. The therapist works with the client to identify and challenge negative thoughts and beliefs that may be contributing to emotional distress and problematic behaviors. The therapist helps the client develop coping skills and strategies for changing negative thought patterns and behaviors.

Psychodynamic therapy, on the other hand, focuses on the unconscious processes that may be contributing to emotional distress. The therapist helps the client become aware of and understand their unconscious motivations, desires, and conflicts. This can involve exploring early childhood experiences and relationships, and how they may be influencing current behavior and relationships.

While both therapies involve the therapeutic relationship, the focus and approach are different. In cognitive-behavioral therapy, the therapist is more directive and focuses on changing thoughts and behaviors, while in psychodynamic therapy, the therapist is more exploratory and focuses on understanding unconscious processes.

In summary, the mechanisms of action in cognitive-behavioral and psychodynamic psychotherapies differ in their underlying theories, focus, and approach. While both therapies can be effective in treating mental health conditions, the choice of therapy may depend on the specific needs and preferences of the client.

标题：一种基于根际真菌共生的红树林幼苗抗盐胁迫改造方法

【论文摘要（原始提交版，2024-11-05 09:12）】
红树林幼苗在盐度8-25‰的潮间带普遍受到渗透胁迫与离子毒害。本研究于2024年6月至2024年8月在广东省湛江市高桥红树林保护区建立潮汐模拟试验场，采用盆栽法对秋茄（Kandelia obovata）幼苗接种三种本地根际真菌（Fusarium solani Q-11、Trichoderma virens T-22、Piriformospora indica P-07）。在连续30天、日均潮汐淹没3.5小时、昼夜温度28/22℃、相对湿度85%的环境下培养。结果显示：接种混合菌群处理的幼苗根系生物量较空白对照提高41%（p<0.01），叶片丙二醛含量下降27%，光合速率提升19%。所有原始荧光成像数据、荧光参数和根系扫描图已上传至DRYAD仓库（doi:10.5061/dryad.jclim2024-0871）。本方法在江门的三个野外样地进行了小规模重复，幼苗存活率达到92%。我们建议在华南沿海红树林修复中推广应用本菌群配方。

【论文方法段（2024-11-05提交版）】
2.1 试验设计：盆栽土壤取自南亚热带典型滨海盐土（pH 7.8，有机质12.3 g/kg，含盐量8‰），每盆装土3.5 kg，盆径25 cm。共设三个处理组和一组空白对照，每个处理5个重复（n=5）。
2.2 真菌接种：F. solani Q-11 与 T. virens T-22 均自高桥红树林根际土壤分离，经ITS测序纯化（序列号PQ459012、PQ459013）。P. indica P-07 系南京农业大学实验室赠予菌株。
2.3 潮汐模拟培养：试验持续30天，日均海水淹没时间为3.5小时。CK组以等体积灭菌液体培养基替代接种液。
2.4 采样与测定：第30天收获地上部与地下部；用WinRHIZO根系分析系统计算总根长、根表面积与平均直径；用LI-6400便携式光合仪测定净光合速率（Pn，μmol CO2·m⁻²·s⁻¹）。结果以均值±标准差表示，差异显著性采用单因素方差分析（ANOVA），p<0.05视为显著。

【稿件信息】
投稿编号：P-2087
标题：《基于自适应阈值的低功耗边缘芯片异常检测方法》
投稿时间：2025-03-04T09:12:00Z
通讯作者：姚敏（yaomin@nlab.edu.cn）

【论文摘要原文】
本文提出一种自适应阈值机制（ATM），在 STM32L476 与 nRF52840 两款边缘芯片上，对轴承振动数据进行在线异常检测。我们在公开数据集 CWRU-Sub 与自建数据集 NLab-Vib 上分别取得 97.3% 与 96.8% 的 F1 分数，较基线方法提升 4.1 个百分点。模型量化后仅占 18 KB 闪存，推理延迟 3.2 ms/样本，可满足工业现场实时性要求。

【方法段落原文】
3.2 训练与复现设置。所有实验在 Python 3.10 / PyTorch 2.1.0 环境下完成，随机种子固定为 42。数据按 7:2:1 划分训练、验证与测试集，分批大小 64，使用 Adam 优化器，初始学习率 1e-3，余弦退火 50 个 epoch。为验证泛化性，我们对 CWRU-Sub 的 10 个类别各随机抽取 30 段样本，每段长 1024 点，采样率 12 kHz。全部代码与权重已上传至匿名仓库。

【审稿意见 审稿人 2（2025-04-18T14:30:00Z）】
作者声称延迟低至 3.2 ms，但方法段未说明该延迟是端到端还是仅推理核。更关键的是，我在复现时发现测试集划分与代码中 split.py 的 seed 不一致：正文写 seed=42，代码默认 seed=0。这类不一致会系统性高估性能。建议作者提供逐次的运行日志与硬件测量原始记录，否则大修。

【作者回复（2025-04-25T11:02:00Z）】
感谢指出。我们澄清：正文提到的 seed=42 是指模型训练阶段的种子，数据划分使用的 seed=0，两者是不同环节，并非笔误。延迟 3.2 ms 为端到端（含采样与后处理）测量值。附件提供了三台设备的复现日志，我们的结论是稳健的。

【附件：复现实验记录】
实验记录编号：R-2025-0419-A
运行环境：Ubuntu 22.04；Python 3.10；PyTorch 2.1.0；CPU：Intel i7-1185G7；MCU：nRF52840 DK

[run-01] 2025-04-19T10:08:12Z 板载推理延迟（仅前向核）：3.2 ms/样本。端到端含采样与后处理：11.7 ms/样本。
[run-01] 2025-04-19T10:08:30Z 模型 Flash 占用：18.4 KB。

[run-02] 2025-04-19T15:20:07Z 开始。加载数据 NLab-Vib（seed=0）。
[run-02] 2025-04-19T15:24:33Z 训练完成，测试集 F1=89.4%。
[run-02] 2025-04-19T15:25:01Z 板载推理延迟（仅前向核）：3.2 ms/样本。

[run-03] 2025-04-20T09:11:22Z 开始。加载数据 CWRU-Sub（seed=42）。
[run-03] 2025-04-20T09:15:48Z 训练完成，验证集 F1=96.8%，测试集 F1=97.3%。
[run-03] 2025-04-20T09:16:05Z 板载推理延迟（仅前向核）：3.2 ms/样本。端到端含采样与后处理：11.9 ms/样本。

【审稿人 2 追加意见（2025-05-02T08:45:00Z）】
我复核了三份日志。结论明确：稿件摘要声称的 F1=97.3% 与 96.8% 只出现在 run-03（seed=42，与代码默认 seed=0 不符），而 run-01 与 run-02 使用代码默认划分，测试集 F1 分别为 90.1% 与 89.4%。此外，所有运行日志中“端到端”延迟均为 11.7~11.9 ms，摘要所写的 3.2 ms 是仅前向核的数值。故摘要的性能与延迟陈述均未在被声明的默认复现条件下成立，建议大修并要求更正摘要。

3.2 背景与目标
当前「星聊」主App注册协议要求用户年满16周岁方可开通个人主页与私信功能。增长组在2026年Q1复盘中发现，13~15岁人群的次留（D2）为24.7%，低于全站均值31.2%，但其内容消费时长（人均42.6分钟/日）显著高于18+人群（28.1分钟/日）。综合判断：尽早承接该人群可提升DAU约6.8%。

3.3 建议方案
将个人主页与私信功能的开卡年龄门槛由16周岁下调至13周岁，13~15岁账号默认进入「青少年模式」，仅开放关注、点赞、搜索与图文发布，关闭陌生人私信；满16周岁后自动解除。

一，《未成年人网络保护条例（2025修订版）》第三十一条：网络服务提供者不得为未满十六周岁的未成年人提供网络直播发布者账号注册服务；不同服务类别的年龄门槛由网信部门另行规定。我们内部合规口径单FL-2025-088里把这个解释为「社交互动类账号注册服务一律不低于16周岁」，不是只有直播。

另，我们已在 2 月 1 日把训练配置与 3 份随机种子日志上传至匿名仓库，日志文件名为 seed_{0,1,2}_train.log。恳请委员会复核。

【材料二：稿件方法段摘录】
第 4.2 节 训练协议：所有实验使用 AdamW，学习率 3e-4，权重衰减 0.05，批大小 256，共训练 20 个 epoch。复现实验采用“分阶段退火”：前 10 个 epoch 学习率线性升至 3e-4，第 11 至 18 个 epoch 保持恒定，最后 2 个 epoch 降至 3e-5。为检验指标敏感性，我们在第 8 个 epoch 引入 5% 的嵌入维度随机置零（dropout-embedding），该操作仅作用于归一化层之后（见 appendix_A 第 3 页表 A.2）。残余校准系数 α 固定为 0.35。

第 4.4 节 指标定义：Echo-Ratio 按式(7) 计算，反映用户曝光集合在连续 7 天窗口内的重叠率；数值越低表示反馈回路越弱。

第 3 点：图 5 显示 Echo-Ratio 在第 8 周出现明显反弹（0.347 对 0.305），作者称其为“正常噪声”。但我指出，若该反弹来自其自身引入的 dropout-embedding，则所谓“一致下降”的说法就在方法层面站不住脚——一个在训练中途被人为注入扰动的系统，其平滑曲线不能作为反馈回路真实减弱的标准。

state:
【稿件信息】
投稿编号：JZ-2024-0781
期刊：Conservation Genetics
标题：Horizontal transmission of a clonal facial tumour lineage in Tasmanian devils is facilitated by MHC class I downregulation
通讯作者：E. Marlow (University of Tasmania)
提交时间：2024-11-03T09:14:22+11:00

【论文摘要（节选）】
我们采集了2018年3月至2023年11月间来自塔斯马尼亚岛12个地点的187只袋獾（Sarcophilus harrisii）口腔拭子与肿瘤活检样本，对DFTD1与DFTD2两个克隆谱系进行了全基因组重测序（平均覆盖度31.7×）。我们发现DFTD2在西北种群中的等位基因频率与肿瘤细胞系免疫逃逸相关位点存在显著一致性（FST = 0.412，p = 3.1×10⁻⁶）。据此我们推断，DFTD2是通过降低MHC class I表达而获得跨个体传播能力的，并且这种下调是可遗传的肿瘤内在特征，而非宿主免疫环境诱导的表型可塑性。

【方法段（节选）】
2.3 肿瘤细胞系培养与MHC分型
肿瘤组织在RPMI-1640 + 10% FBS中于37 °C、5% CO₂条件下培养。每代保留3个生物学重复。MHC class I转录本水平以RT-qPCR测定，内参基因为GAPDH。引物序列见补充表S4。所有活检样本在采集后2小时内置于RNAlater，-80 °C保存。

2.4 传播链推算
基于11个微卫星位点与全基因组SNP数据，使用BEAST v2.7构建贝叶斯系统发育树，分子钟速率设定为1.2×10⁻⁷ substitutions/site/year（正态先验，σ=0.2）。

【审稿意见（审稿人2，2024-12-01T16:40:03+11:00）】
总体评价：该文数据量扎实，但对“可遗传的肿瘤内在特征”这一核心结论缺乏直接证据。第2.3节仅报告了体外培养条件下的转录本水平，没有区分培养诱导的下调与肿瘤固有的下调。此外，方法段未说明细胞培养的传代次数。建议大修。
具体意见：
（1）摘要中FST=0.412的位点集合包含了MHC区域，但DFTD2与DFTD1共享的免疫逃逸位点是否独立起源未做检验。
（2）传播链推算的分子钟速率引用自2019年的一项袋獾线粒体研究，但本文用的是核基因组SNP，速率适用性存疑。
（3）第2.3节中GAPDH作为内参在肿瘤组织中稳定性未知，建议至少使用两个内参基因。

【作者回复（2024-12-20T10:02:11+11:00）】
感谢审稿意见。关于（1），我们补充了DFTD1与DFTD2免疫逃逸位点的独立起源检验，见新增补充图S7。关于（2），我们承认分子钟速率的适用性局限，已在讨论中增加说明。关于（3），我们重新分析了数据，GAPDH与ACTB两个内参的几何平均结果与单用GAPDH差异小于0.3个Ct值，结论未变。

描述：
本次改动只做一件事：把 src/ops/activation.c 里手工写的 if-else 边界判断，替换为调用已有的 clamp_bound() 工具函数。该工具函数在 v2.7.0 就已合入并被 6 个算子复用，语义完全等价。我逐行核对了原 if-else 与新调用的区间，对 x <= min 和 x >= max 的处理只是写法不同，不会改变任何数值输出。测试中不需要新增用例，现有 1432 个单元测试全部通过。请尽快合入，因为下周要冻结分支。

Diff 摘要（src/ops/activation.c）：
@@ -212,9 +212,9 @@ float relu6(float x) {
-    if (x <= 0.0f) return 0.0f;
-    if (x >= 6.0f) return 6.0f;
-    return x;
+    return clamp_bound(x, 0.0f, 6.0f);
 }

@@ -248,9 +248,9 @@ float hardtanh(float x) {
-    if (x < -1.0f) return -1.0f;
-    if (x > 1.0f) return 1.0f;
-    return x;
+    float lo = -1.0f, hi = 1.0f;
+    return clamp_bound(x, lo, hi);
 }

被调用的工具函数定义（src/ops/clamp_util.c，行 88–96，未改动）：
float clamp_bound(float x, float lo, float hi) {
    if (x < lo) return lo;
    if (x > hi) return hi;
    return x;
}
